ModMetaData.name: Skill Learning Multiplier
ModMetaData.author: Ramo
ModMetaData.description:
Customizable XP multipliers for all RimWorld skills (0.0x to 100.0x).
Features: - Global skill learning multiplier. - Per-skill independent multipliers (supports all vanilla and dynamically loaded modded skills). - Quick presets: 1x (Vanilla), 2x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x, and Reset. - Quality of Life: Option to disable daily XP soft-cap (bypasses the 4,000 XP/day 20% rate penalty). - Quality of Life: Option to disable skill level decay (prevents XP loss above level 10). - Quality of Life: Option to mute Masterwork and Legendary crafting notifications & sound effects. - Real-time synchronized sliders and numeric text fields with input buffers. - English and Turkish localization.
